summary: One setting of a work item changed: when it may start, when it is due, its priority, its limits, its execution profile or its result format; a change of several settings writes one line for each.

old.description: The setting's value before the change.

new.description: The setting's value after the change.

old.description: The item's own limit, or null for the installation's.

new.description: The item's own limit, or null for the installation's.

old.description: The profile's name, or null when the item names none.

new.description: The profile's name, or null when the item names none.

old.description: The caller's JSON Schema for the role's result, or null for none; an object since the runtime checks it, any JSON value an earlier release accepted.

new.description: The caller's JSON Schema for the role's result, or null for none; an object since the runtime checks it, any JSON value an earlier release accepted.
